data.name: King Assassination
data.detailed_description:
The King must survive. The Assassins must strike. The Guards must stop them.

Enter a dangerous kingdom where every stranger could be an enemy, every shadow could hide an Assassin, and one mistake can change the entire game.

King Assassination is a fast-paced multiplayer deception and action game where two teams fight over one objective:

Protect the King — or kill him.

⚔️ CHOOSE YOUR SIDE

🛡️ THE GUARDS

Your mission is simple: keep the King alive.

Stay close, watch the crowd, investigate suspicious players, and use your unique abilities to protect your King.

But be careful...

Kill too many innocent players, and you become the threat.

🗡️ THE ASSASSINS

Blend into the crowd. Stay hidden. Wait for the perfect opportunity.

Assassins can eliminate their targets only from behind, making positioning, deception, and patience essential.

One perfectly timed strike can turn a peaceful escort into complete chaos.

👑 PROTECT THE KING

The King isn't just another player.

Kings travel through the kingdom along their routes while both teams fight around them. Guards must keep them alive and moving, while Assassins search for the perfect moment to strike.

Protect the King. Follow the route. Trust no one.

🎭 EVERYONE IS A SUSPECT

You never truly know who is on your side.

An innocent player might look suspicious.
An Assassin might look completely harmless.
A Guard might accidentally kill the wrong person.

Read the situation. Watch player behavior. Make decisions under pressure.

One wrong decision could cost your entire team the game.

💥 TEAMWORK OR DECEPTION

Guards must work together to identify threats, heal wounded teammates, and defend the King.

Assassins must coordinate their attacks, stay hidden, and exploit every opportunity.

Whether you are protecting, hunting, deceiving, or simply trying to survive...

every player matters.

🏆 WHO WILL WIN?

The battle ends when the objective is decided:

  • Assassins win by eliminating the required Kings, eliminating all Guards, or fulfilling their team objective.

  • Guards win by protecting the required Kings, eliminating all Assassins, or fulfilling their team objective.

  • The match can also end when the last King reaches the destination.

No two matches unfold the same way.

🔥 TRUST NO ONE

A quiet escort can become a bloodbath in seconds.

A suspicious player could be innocent.

The person standing beside you could be the Assassin you've been searching for all game.

Watch your back. Protect your King.

And when the moment comes...

ASSASSINATE THE KING.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (2 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 460 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Targeted for 1080p / 60 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 (8 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Targeted for 1080p / +120 FPS
